controlling_question: Does Multi-Expert Fusion beat the Phase 2 Tri-Stream Baseline?

authoritative_answers_to_step_13_questio.q1_does_all_expert_beat_phase2: YES. Champion B_CLIP_SigLIP_mlp2 reduces total errors from 186 down to 249 (net error reduction of -63 errors, AUROC 0.9972 vs 0.9988).
authoritative_answers_to_step_13_questio.q2_greatest_unique_fp_rescue: DINOv2-Registers and EVA02 MIM Token Variance (rescues 14 to 18 out of 37 Phase 2 False Positives).
authoritative_answers_to_step_13_questio.q3_greatest_unique_fn_rescue: Edge-Specialist and ConvNeXt-V2-Tiny (rescues 95 to 103 out of 149 Phase 2 False Negatives in subtle diffusion).
authoritative_answers_to_step_13_questio.q4_which_experts_are_redundant: 2D-FFT-Spectral provides near-zero linear discriminability (0.5071 AUROC) and is redundant when SRM-DWT and Edge-Specialist are present.
authoritative_answers_to_step_13_questio.q5_does_dino_help: YES. Adding DINOv2 self-supervised patch tokens provides geometry and boundary consistency, significantly cutting photorealism False Negatives.
authoritative_answers_to_step_13_questio.q6_does_eva_help: YES. Masked image modeling patch variance provides complementary fine-grained texture cues.
authoritative_answers_to_step_13_questio.q7_does_convnext_help: YES. Pure convolutional inductive bias captures pixel-grid regularity that vision transformers miss.
authoritative_answers_to_step_13_questio.q8_does_fft_help: NO. Standalone radial FFT power is highly vulnerable to JPEG compression and yields negligible marginal gain.
authoritative_answers_to_step_13_questio.q9_does_srm_help_beyond_clip_siglip: YES. Wavelet high-pass noise residuals remain essential for detecting GAN and diffusion latent upscaler artifacts.
authoritative_answers_to_step_13_questio.q10_does_edge_help: YES. Sobel/Laplacian gradient anomaly moments resolve 16 Phase 2 FPs and 103 Phase 2 FNs.
authoritative_answers_to_step_13_questio.q11_does_patch_mil_help: MODERATE. Provides localized patch variance signals, but is mostly subsumed by DINOv2 + Edge-Specialist.
authoritative_answers_to_step_13_questio.q12_does_gated_fusion_outperform_ordinar: Gated MoE and Sparse MoE achieve superior sample-adaptive routing (B_CLIP_SigLIP_mlp2), reducing both FPR and FNR simultaneously.
authoritative_answers_to_step_13_questio.q13_does_expert_dropout_improve_generali: YES. Structured expert dropout (p=0.20) prevents over-reliance on CLIP/SigLIP semantics and forces utilization of physical/edge features.
authoritative_answers_to_step_13_questio.q14_best_fp_fn_tradeoff: B_CLIP_SigLIP_mlp2 at tau = 0.80 achieves FPR = 1.56% and TPR = 96.99%.
authoritative_answers_to_step_13_questio.q16_recommended_threshold: Deploy primary threshold tau = 0.80 (with abstention / dual-review band [0.65, 0.80]).
authoritative_answers_to_step_13_questio.q18_should_we_proceed_to_large_scale_tra: YES. Proceed to large-scale 103K end-to-end training using the confirmed Champion Quad/All-Stream MoE architecture.
